scripts.title: Aimbot and Glow Update v22
scripts.features:
🔥 AIM ASSIST UI v22 — by DrNeusence
A sleek, high-performance aim assist script for Roblox. Built with modern graphics, smooth animations, and an intuitive interface.

🎮 Features
✨ Aimbot
Hold RMB to lock onto the nearest enemy inside the FOV circle.

Smooth camera tracking with dynamic lerp for natural aiming.

Auto‑switch to the next visible enemy when your target dies.

Visible & team check – only targets enemies you can see and are on opposing teams.

Customisable hitbox (head, torso, root) via settings.

FOV circle glows and changes colour when a target is locked.

✨ Glow ESP
Toggleable outlines on enemies (red) and yourself (blue).

Highlights work through walls and automatically update when characters spawn.

✨ UI
Dark glassmorphic design with gradient title bar and pulsing border.

Draggable – move the window anywhere.

Typewriter tooltips – hover over buttons for animated descriptions.

Insert key toggles the entire UI (hide/show).

Fully optimised, no memory leaks.

🧪 How to Use
Insert – show/hide the menu.

AIMBOT button – turns the aimbot on/off (green = on, red = off).

GLOW button – toggles enemy/self outlines.

Hold RMB (right mouse button) while the aimbot is on to lock onto enemies inside the FOV circle. Release to unlock.

📜 Credits
Created by DrNeusence.
Inspired by the desire for a clean, efficient, and visually appealing aim assist tool. Enjoy!

scripts.title: ESP AIMBOT FOV INF AMMO AND MORE
scripts.features:
Aimbot Improvements:

Fully reworked Aimbot – Improved target acquisition, smoother tracking, and better performance.

FOV Circle – Customizable radius, color, and transparency; visual feedback when locked on target.

Hold/Toggle Key System – Choose between hold or toggle mode with any key binding (mouse or keyboard).

Team Check & Wall Check – Configurable to avoid teammates and respect obstacles.

Aimbot Smoothing – Adjustable from instant to smooth tracking.

NEW Movement Tab:

Fly Hack – Toggle with INSERT key; WASD + Space/Ctrl controls; adjustable speed (20-200).

Noclip – Walk through walls; toggle with DELETE key.

Fly Speed Slider – Customize flight velocity on the fly.

ESP:

ESP Toggles – Player Name and Box ESP (requires Drawing support).

Gun Modifications:

Rainbow Gun – Dynamic color cycling for weapon models.

Infinite Ammo – Standard quality-of-life feature.

Misc:

Infinite Jump – Toggleable infinite jumping.

UI & Visuals:

Fixed UI – All tabs (Main, Movement, ESP, Gun, Misc, Credits) now display correctly in WindUI.

New "Movement" tab – Centralized all mobility features.

Clean UI integration – No visual glitches or overlapping elements.

Controls:

Key    Action
K    Open/Close UI
INSERT    Toggle Fly
DELETE    Toggle Noclip
WASD    Move / Fly
Space    Fly up
Ctrl    Fly down
Right Click    Aim Assist (hold)
Works on:

Delta

Solara

Velocity

Xeno

Any executor with Drawing support

Thank you for your support!
